column1: Terrestrial Protected Areas by IBRA Bioregions in Australia (2024)
1. Area is based on calculated GIS_AREA data (rather than gazetted areas). GIS_AREA is the area in hectares based on current spatial data and an Albers equal area projection for Australia.
*IBRA regions do not extend to the Antarctic land and water areas.

*Some protected areas or parts of protected areas are not within IBRA regions/subregions (e.g. ASMAs and ASPAs are not reported). Only the protected area within IBRA regions/subregions are included in the table above. Therefore the total area protected reported here may be slightly less than in the 'Type' and 'IUCN Category' tabs. Overlaps are excluded from this table.

* Only protected areas that meet the standard for inclusion in the NRS are included in this table. For details see the Technical Specification document at - https://www.dcceew.gov.au/environment/land/nrs/science/capad/2024.

* Both the Subantarctic Islands and Coral Sea Bioregions are 100% protected by reserves that are represented in the Marine CAPAD statistics. The Subantarctic Islands Bioregion is protected by the Heard and McDonald Island Marine Reserve and Macquarie Island Nature Reserve. The Coral Sea Bioregion is protected by the Coral Sea Australian Marine Park. See the Marine CAPAD spreadsheets.
*IBRA protection values are calculated using IBRA 7.1 (published 2025). Prior to CAPAD 2024, IBRA 7.0 was used.
